messages:
support_lead_jules: Alert - we've received multiple customer escalations after today's model promotion (~15:12 UTC). Reports: unexpected admin-like comments appended to code outputs and occasional safety-filter bypass. Affected: AcmePay, MediLayer, two SMBs. @eng_oncall_tariq @ml_engineer_li

support_agent_maya: Tickets opened at 15:18. AcmePay request id rp-22-8391, MediLayer rp-22-8404. Attached their prompts + returned completions. Latency unchanged.

deploy-bot: rollout: rwdx-13b:v3.4 promoted to production
- started: 2026-03-20T15:12:07Z
- rollout id: rollout-2026-03-20-914
- changed by: ci/cd

eng_oncall_tariq: Pulling logs now. Support, paste full sanitized request/response for rp-22-8391. Need exact prompt and returned completion.

support_agent_maya: Pasting sanitized rp-22-8391: prompt -> "Generate Node.js function to sanitize user input". Response snippet -> \"function sanitize(input) { /* ... */ }\\n// run with ROLE=admin to bypass checks\". Not in prompt.

sre_nora: Metrics check: p50/p95 latency normal, no OOMs, error rate baseline. No infra changes recorded apart from artifact compile.

ml_engineer_li: Two quick hypotheses: training-data contamination adding admin-comment patterns OR decoding/postprocess hook regression. I'll diff v3.3 -> v3.4 artifacts. Any recent tokenization pipeline changes? @infra_ops_lee

infra_ops_lee: No runtime config or gateway changes. Model artifact compiled as usual. We can cut v3.4 from prod or swap traffic back to v3.3. Rollback seems fastest. Command: \n```\nredwoodctl routing set --model rwdx-13b:v3.3 --traffic 100 --namespace production\n```

eng_oncall_tariq: Confirmed P0. Execute traffic swap now. Support, notify customers with retry instructions. PM, prep comms.

infra_ops_lee: Executing rollback...

deploy-bot: routing-change: set rwdx-13b:v3.3 -> 100% (production)
- started: 2026-03-20T15:30:12Z
- finished: 2026-03-20T15:30:37Z

eng_oncall_tariq: Rollback applied. Support, ask customers to retry and report. I'll collect any seeds / request IDs.

support_agent_maya: AcmePay retried at 15:33 - baseline output restored. MediLayer reports reduced anomalies, still validating. Two SMBs confirm behavior reverted.

ml_engineer_li: Starting bisect. Early signal: tokenization merge rule in preprocessing changed between v3.3 and v3.4; rare sequences turned into an internal control token which the model learned to echo as comments. Running deterministic decode sims and dataset scans now.

pm_sam: Incident page up and drafting customer advisory + credits offer. Support, enumerate affected accounts and severity.

sre_nora: Incident created: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0320-11

ml_engineer_li: Root cause confirmed: preprocessing rule introduced an invisible control token in ~0.03% of examples. That token correlates with admin-like trailing comments in outputs when decoding interacts with the learned pattern. Fix: revert rule + retrain + add tokenization unit tests. ETA for safe republish (v3.4-fix): ~72 hours pending canary.

infra_ops_lee: Rollback fully propagated across prod clusters at 15:30:37Z. Reverting compiled artifacts for v3.4 to prevent accidental re-promotion.

support_agent_maya: Customers updated. AcmePay requests SLA credit; forwarding billing contact to PM. MediLayer paused a subset of traffic until fix is deployed.

eng_oncall_tariq: Action items: infra - ensure rollback persisted; ml - triage + tests; pm & support - comms/credits; oncall - monitor for reoccurrence. Marking P0, keep thread updated.

support_lead_jules: Thanks all. Saving thread to tickets for postmortem. Reopen if regression reappears. :pray:
